claim.notes: Vanilla CFR, 20000 iterations, full deal enumeration. Exploitability computed exactly by a best-response pass over the exact game tree, and is about 0.0077 (about 0.4% of the 2-chip first-round raise size). Value of p0 under the saved strategy is -0.0856. The game implementation is my own from the stated rules and was not cross-checked against an external one. It is an approximate equilibrium, not an exact one.
